notes.title: Patch Uploaded
notes.content:
Thanks for all of the crash logs sent to mailbox@darkartzentertainment.com  We were able to nail down and fix 2 different causes for the reported crashes.  Please continue to send any problems to the prementioned email address.  The patch should rollout later today.

FIXES ::
1) Crashes involving Linked Lists in memory
2) Invites no longer being sent to your friends on lobby join

notes.title: Patch in the Works
notes.content:
Since launch we have seen a couple new bugs that we are currently addressing:

1) Invites being sent to your friends list
2) Reports of crashes from certain systems

We have identified the problems with these issues and are currently resolving them.  Thanks for your patience with these errors.
